transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed and down, and this heavy sadness just won't go away. It has been like this continuously every single day for the past four months.
Have you had periods of depressed mood that lasted for at least two years, with symptoms present more days than not during that time?
No, it hasn't been going on for two years. This really just started about four months ago, but it has been completely constant since then.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities you used to enjoy?
I haven't really noticed a loss of interest in the things I usually do. I'm not entirely sure, to be honest.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "appetite",
  "question": "Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?"
Yes, my appetite has dropped significantly and I find it really hard to eat almost every day. Because of that, I've lost a lot of weight recently without even trying to diet.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "sleep",
  "question": "Have you been having trouble sleeping or sleeping more than usual?"
No, my sleep has been relatively normal and hasn't really changed. I haven't had any major trouble falling asleep or sleeping too much.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "fatigue",
  "question": "Have you been feeling more tired or fatigued than usual, even when you haven't done much physically?"

Yes, I've been feeling incredibly exhausted, both physically and mentally. My body constantly feels so heavy, and even after resting or doing very minor things, I feel completely drained of any energy to get through the day.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "concentration",
  "question": "Have you had trouble concentrating, making decisions, or thinking clearly lately?"
I haven't really noticed any major issues with my concentration or making decisions. Things seem okay in that area, or at least I'm not entirely sure if there has been any change.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "guilt",
  "question": "Have you been feeling excessive guilt, worthlessness, or self-blame, even when things aren't your fault?"
No, I haven't really been feeling excessive guilt or blaming myself for things. I don't feel worthless, it's just that my mood is very low.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "anhedonia",
  "question": "To clarify, have you been able to experience pleasure in any activities at all during the past four months, even if only mildly or occasionally?"
I'm not quite sure, and I haven't really thought about whether I can experience mild pleasure lately. Everything just feels generally flat or numb to me right now.

{
  "category": "symptom interpretation",
  "subcategory": "anhedonia",
  "question": "When you say everything feels flat or numb, does that include not feeling enjoyment or satisfaction from things you used to like, even small things?"

I'm not really sure, to be honest, because I haven't thought about enjoyment much lately. It is more that my emotions just feel completely dull and paralyzed, like a general state of numbness where I don't feel much of anything.

No symptoms suggest mania, psychosis, anxiety, trauma, or eating disorder behaviors, so other diagnoses are not currently indicated.
